name: Property Rent Roll Report
description: A rent roll report providing a summary of commercial lease details for a specific property.
key_questions: What is the name of the property listed in the rent roll?
What is the total net area (sq.m.) for the tenants?
Who is the tenant occupying the unit/suite?
What is the lease start and end date?
What is the annual base rent amount?
What is the recovery type (e.g., NNN)?
